Data visualizations

World Bank data for 217 economies, 1960 to 2023. The charts are built in src/common/figures.py, with tests in tests/test_figures.py. This notebook only displays them. Hover over any chart to see exact values.

1. Life expectancy by income group

Create a time-series line chart showing how life expectancy at birth has changed over the years for each income group. Every group rose, and the poorest gained most: low income went from 39.8 to 64.2 years (+24.4), and high income from 65.1 to 79.8 (+14.7). The low income dip in 2009 comes largely from one country, Central African Republic.
